{{Quote|Yes, I ''did'' sit down and talk surrender terms with Loathsom, over a cup of tarine tea. He became most ungentlemanly when he realized it was ''his'' surrender we were talking about. Have these people no manners? He didn't even offer me a sweet-sand cookie.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, talking afterwards about his surrender to Whorm Loathsom|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars novelization'']]</ref>}}
'''Tarine tea''' was a variety of [[Tea/Legends|tea]]. It was could be served with [[Sweet-sand cookie/Legends|Sweet-sand cookies]].

==History==
[[Rondai-2]] and [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] were locations where the tea was served. As [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] attempted to stall for time during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], he asked the enemy commander, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]], for some refreshments while they negotiated and was obliged with a cup of Tarine tea.
